Key terms, in plain language
For non-technical readers · numbers match the diagram above
ETL (Talend)2
Extract–Transform–Load: automatically pulls data out of source systems, tidies it into one shape and loads it into the central store — like gathering every branch’s report into one template and one folder.
Bronze·Silver·Gold3–5
Three refinement stages: Bronze keeps data raw, exactly as received; Silver cleans and joins it; Gold makes it ready for KPIs and management reports.
Trino6
A query engine that answers questions across data stored in many places, in seconds — like an archivist who knows which shelf holds what and brings it straight to you.
Starburst6
The enterprise edition of Trino. It adds access control (who may see which data), security, vendor support and a management console.
Apache Iceberg9
An open standard that manages thousands of data files as one orderly table — a table of contents recording which file holds what and when it changed.
Parquet9
A file format that stores data column by column, compressed. It takes a fraction of the space of Excel/CSV and is fast because only the columns needed are read.
Time travel9
See data exactly as it was on any past date — “what was stock on hand on the 1st?” — and roll back a mistaken change.
OpenMetadata10
The company’s data directory: what data exists, where it lives, who owns it, where it came from and whether its quality checks pass — one place to find and trust data.
AWS Bedrock7
Amazon’s service for building AI assistants on ready-made large language models. AgentCore adds what an AI agent needs to run safely at company scale: runtime, identity, memory and access to tools.
MCP7
Model Context Protocol — a common standard that lets AI agents safely use tools such as the query engine and data catalog. Like a universal plug: one standard, many devices.

TBFIN — AI agent architecture
Final hybrid design: four business agents on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore in Tokyo; data, execution and evidence in Mongolia, joined by a private VPN.

Flow
1
Prepare data
Source systems feed Starburst, which publishes only governed, read-only views.
2
Filter at the border
An allowlist decides what may leave; GPS, addresses and free text never leave.
3
Private link
Runtime ENI → VGW → 2 IPsec tunnels → customer gateway → approved views.
4
NBA decides
Stage + segmentation → strategy → message + compliance → decision ID, context, script.
5
Hand off
Digital → Action agent; field → Route optimiser; voice → AG-304.
6
Execute in Mongolia
Gateway tools call domestic services; every dispatch passes deterministic checks.
7
Store evidence
Outcomes go to CRM and the domestic evidence store; the audit ledger links them.
8
Monitor & control
Sanitised telemetry → CloudWatch → Evaluations; no un-piloted rule is released.
9
Measure
KPI / KCI / KRI snapshots on domestic events prove the business result.
A
Private invocation
Operator UI → domestic API → VPN → interface VPC endpoint → Runtime API.

Key terms, in plain language
For non-technical readers · numbers point to the steps above
Starburst view1
A governed “window” onto a table that shows only approved columns and rows. Agents see this window, never the raw table.
Allowlist2
A list of what is permitted. Anything not on the list is blocked automatically — “open only what is approved”, not “block what is forbidden”.
Opaque reference · tokenisation2
A meaningless code (e.g. JOB-8F3K) travels instead of a name or address; the key to decode it stays in Mongolia. This is not full anonymisation.
VPN · IPsec tunnel3
An encrypted private pipe between the Mongolian network and AWS. Two tunnels: if one drops, the other keeps working.
VPC · ENI3
VPC is the company’s closed network inside AWS. An ENI is a network card plugged into it — the Runtime reaches domestic systems through it.
AgentCore Runtime3–4
The AWS-managed place where the AI agents run. No servers to maintain; every session is isolated from the others.
NBA — Next Best Action4
For each case, the action that is most likely to work right now — e.g. send an SMS today, call, or visit in person.
LangGraph4
A framework that arranges an agent’s steps into a flow with order and conditions: classify → choose strategy → check the message.
Compliance4
Checks that every contact follows the law and internal rules: allowed hours, frequency limits, no threatening language.
DPD · bucket · cure4 · 9
DPD = days a payment is late. A bucket groups loans by lateness (1–30, 31–60 days…). Cure = the loan returns to on-time status.
IVR · STT / TTS5–6
IVR is the automated phone menu (“press 1 for…”). STT turns speech into text, TTS turns text into speech — here in Mongolian.
SIP · PSTN · carrier5–6
The technology that puts a call onto the regular phone network (PSTN), operated by a telecom carrier. The provider is still to be chosen.
Geocoder · route optimiser5–6
A geocoder turns an address into a map point; the optimiser orders the day’s visits for the shortest route and time.
Idempotency · reversal5–6
Idempotency: repeating an action by mistake still executes it once (no duplicate SMS). Reversal: the procedure to cancel or compensate a wrong action.
Deterministic rule5–6 · 8
A fixed rule that always gives the same result for the same input. AI may suggest, but these rules always check before a real dispatch.
Audit ledger7
An unchangeable record of recommendation → action → outcome, kept in Mongolia as the official evidence.
Observability · OTel trace8
Records, line by line, what the agent did at every step (a trace). OpenTelemetry is the open standard for it.
Pilot · release gate8
A new rule is first tried on 10% of the loan portfolio; it is opened to everyone only after the result is approved.
IAM · Secrets Manager · KMS8
AWS services that control who may access what (IAM), store passwords and keys (Secrets Manager) and manage encryption keys (KMS).
KPI · KCI · KRI · baseline9
KPI: is it performing? KCI: are the controls followed? KRI: is risk rising? Baseline: the pre-AI starting level that results are compared with.
Final design: four business agents hosted on AgentCore; raw location processing and evidence remain in Mongolia.
Before deployment, confirm region features, models, carrier and Mongolian speech provider. Tokenisation is not anonymisation — assess which personal-data transfers are permitted.
Mongolia-only storage is the stated policy boundary; its current legal applicability still needs confirmation.

Ask
An executive asks in chat: “cash vs plan today?”
2
Identify

3
Plan
The agent in Runtime plans with a model and its memory.
4
Check
Policy allows only a read-only query for this role.
5
Fetch
Gateway calls gold_sql_query → Trino → Gold.
6
Answer & log
Answer with source; every step traced in Observability.
What C-level leaders can do with MCP
Leaders ask the AI agent in plain language and get answers straight from the Datalake House
Case 1Group CEO · CFO · subsidiary CEOs
Group Finance — real-time data
Example question
“As of today, what are cash balances and month-to-date revenue versus plan across all subsidiaries? Which company is furthest behind, and why?”
What happens behind it
AI agent (Bedrock)→MCP→OpenMetadata: definitions→Trino → Gold
What leadership gets
  • Today’s numbers without waiting for month-end close
  • All ERPs (SAP, SAP B1, Odoo) compared in one question
  • Every figure traceable to its source system
GuardrailFreshness follows the Talend load schedule; each executive sees only the companies their role allows.
Case 2Chief Audit Executive · CFO · Audit committee
Group real-time audit
Example question
“In the last 30 days, show payments above approval limits, duplicate supplier invoices and transactions posted outside working hours — across the group.”
What happens behind it
AI agent (Bedrock)→MCP→Trino: audit rules→Time travel: evidence
What leadership gets
  • From yearly sample audits to continuous monitoring
  • Suspicious items flagged the same day
  • Snapshots prove what the data showed, and when
GuardrailRead-only: the agent cannot change records, and every question it answers is logged.
Case 3TB Finance CEO · Chief Risk Officer · Sales lead
Finance NBA — Tavan Bogd Finance
Example question
“This week, which customers should we offer a renewal or top-up, and which are at risk of falling overdue? Give the next best action for each.”
What happens behind it
AI agent (Bedrock)→MCP→Trino: loans · CRM · Loyalty→Scoring → action
What leadership gets
  • Early warning before a loan goes overdue
  • Right offer to the right customer, with the reason stated
  • Reminders can hand off to the FindOn collection agent
GuardrailPeople make the final decision; customer personal data stays masked by role.
